title: Technical Issues Associated with Issuance of HDB Flat Eligibility Letters
what_it_is: Technical Issues Associated with Issuance of HDB Flat Eligibility Letters

sections.label: HFE applications processed since May 2023
sections.summary: HDB has processed more than 50,000 HFE applications since the HFE letter was implemented on 9 May 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since the HFE letter was implemented on 9 May 2023, HDB has processed more than 50,000 HFE applications.

sections.label: HFE system manual intervention cases
sections.summary: The HFE system could not yet handle some complexities in integrating eligibility assessments with data from various agencies, causing more cases needing manual intervention than expected.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At the same time, the HFE system was not yet able to handle some complexities in integrating eligibility assessments with data from various agencies, resulting in a higher-than-expected proportion of cases requiring manual intervention.

sections.label: HFE outcomes for October launch
sections.summary: For the launch running 4 to 10 October, HDB commits that applicants who submitted HFE applications and supporting documents before end of August receive outcomes in time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: For the upcoming, in fact, it is the current launch, which runs from 4 October to 10 October, HDB's commitment is to ensure that those who have submitted the HFE applications as well as the supporting documents prior to end of August would receive their HFE outcomes in time to take part in the launch.

sections.label: HDB statement on 21 working days
sections.summary: According to the HDB statement, it takes up to 21 working days for HFE applications to be processed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: According to the HDB statement, it said, "It takes up to 21 working days for HFE applications to be processed.

sections.label: 21-day service standard and outcomes
sections.summary: The 21 days is a service standard; about 31% of HFE applications were processed within it, and applicants did not miss the May BTO launch.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: The 21 days that Mr Pritam Singh has referred to is a service standard.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: So, for the applications that he is referring to, we have about 31% of our HFE applications that were processed within the service standard of 21 days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, because HDB has also been expediting the processing and they have also made accommodations at their end, to HDB's knowledge, applicants were not made to miss out on the May BTO launch, even if they received their HFE outcomes after the 21 days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And for the resale applications, for those who have encountered difficulties and have reached out to HDB for help, they have all been helped.
